name: Winter's Embrace: Ravenstone Tavern
source:
This is a winter themed visual novel for Winter VN Jam 2023. The visual novel takes place in the fictional world of Eldorsa, following our protagonist, Elara Nevistra! After a freakish snow storm, she is trapped inside her family's tavern with some unusual guests.

Now's your chance to learn about your guests' unusual pasts, discover their interests and dreams, enjoy a game or two of chess, share a meal (or three), and maybe, just maybe, fall in love with one of them.

[From [url=https://ashelucia.itch.io/winters-embrace-ravenstone-tavern]itch.io[/url]]
